name: Advanced Autocomplete Orders for WooCommerce – By HappyDevs
author: HappyDevs

sections.description:
Advanced Autocomplete Orders for WooCommerce – Simplify WooCommerce Orders management and boost your store’s efficiency! Automatically update orders to ‘Completed’ right after purchase, ensuring a seamless experience for both you and your customers. Take control of your WooCommerce Order Status and save valuable time!

👉 User Guide | Youtube Video Tutorials | Get Support | Upgrade to Premium

FEATURES

✅ Enable/Disable Autocompletion
✅ Order Types Restriction
✅ Order Total (min/max) Restriction
✅ Shipping Methods Restriction
✅ Payment Methods Restriction
✅ Products Restriction [PRO]
✅ Product Categories Restriction [PRO]
✅ Product Tags Restriction [PRO]
✅ Product Brands Restriction [PRO]
✅ Product Types Restriction [PRO]
✅ User Role Restriction [PRO]
✅ Current Order Status Restriction [PRO]

Managing orders efficiently is one of the biggest challenges for WooCommerce store owners. With the Advanced Autocomplete Order for WooCommerce plugin, you can now automatically complete orders in your WooCommerce store and streamline the entire order processing workflow.

This plugin is designed to automate order processing, saving you time and enhancing your store’s efficiency.

What Is Autocomplete WooCommerce Orders?

Updating Advanced Autocomplete Order for WooCommerce feature ensures that your WooCommerce store automatically updates order statuses without manual intervention. Once a customer completes their purchase, the plugin kicks in to automatically mark orders as complete, eliminating the need for store administrators to change statuses manually.

Whether you run a digital store or sell physical products, this tool helps you achieve seamless order processing by ensuring orders are processed efficiently from start to finish.

Which Features does Autocomplete WooCommerce Orders Cover?

✅ Enable/Disable Autocompletion
Easily toggle the autocomplete feature for WooCommerce orders. Perfect for stores needing manual processing or automated order management. Keeps your workflow flexible.

✅ Order Types Restriction
Limit autocomplete functionality based on specific WooCommerce order types like regular, subscription, or custom. Gain full control over how different orders are handled.

✅ Order Total (Min/Max) Restriction
Automatically complete orders only if their total amount falls within your defined range. Set minimum and maximum order total values, and decide whether to include or exclude them. Perfect for applying rules based on order value.

✅ Shipping Methods Restriction
Restrict order auto-completion based on selected shipping methods. Choose to include or exclude specific shipping options, ensuring only the right orders are auto-completed depending on how they are shipped.

✅ Payment Gateways Restriction
Allow or block autocompletion for specific WooCommerce payment methods (e.g., Cash on Delivery, PayPal, Stripe). Improve fulfillment accuracy based on payment behavior.

✅ Products Restriction [PRO]
Restrict automatic order completion based on individual products. Ideal for stores selling both digital and physical goods with different fulfillment needs.

✅ Product Categories Restriction [PRO]
Control autocompletion using WooCommerce product categories. Useful when certain categories (like pre-orders or subscriptions) require manual handling.

✅ Product Tags Restriction [PRO]
Enable fine-grained control by limiting autocompletion based on product tags. Easily manage special items like “backorder,” “custom-made,” or “exclusive.”

✅ Product Brands Restriction [PRO]
Use WooCommerce brand taxonomy to define autocompletion behavior. Great for stores working with multiple vendors or suppliers with different delivery methods.

✅ Product Types Restriction [PRO]
Target specific product types (simple, variable, downloadable, etc.) to customize the autocompletion workflow. Makes fulfillment smarter and product-aware.

✅ User Role Restriction [PRO]
Set rules based on WooCommerce user roles like Customer, Subscriber, or Wholesale Buyer. Offer custom experiences for different customer types.

✅ Current Order Status Restriction [PRO]
Trigger autocomplete only when orders are in specific statuses (e.g., Processing, On Hold). Gives you precision control over when an order is considered complete.

👉 Upgrade to Premium

Streamlined Order Completion

The Autocomplete Orders plugin simplifies the order process by automatically setting your WooCommerce Order Status to “Completed.” No more manually updating order statuses; this plugin does the work for you, saving time and allowing you to focus on growing your business.

Boosted Customer Experience

With Autocomplete Orders, your customers will appreciate the immediate update of their Order Status. By automatically completing orders, you enhance customer trust and satisfaction, ensuring they know their purchases are being processed efficiently and without delay.

sections.faq:
Our plugin is user friendly, but here you can see some frequently asked
questions that can help you.

Can I use this plugin for physical products?

Yes, while it’s most commonly used for virtual and downloadable products, you can configure it to automatically set orders for physical products too.

What happens if I manually update an order status?

Manual updates will override the automatic settings, giving you full control when needed.
